Kokoro-82M v1.0

Model project: https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M
Code: https://github.com/hexgrad/kokoro
Architecture: StyleTTS 2 (Li et al.) and ISTFTNet
Model trainer credited by upstream: @rzvzn
License: Apache License 2.0. The complete license is packaged with the model.

The model is redistributed as the official sherpa-onnx Kokoro v1.0 int8 export,
including the October 26, 2026 STFT quantization correction.
Export project: https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx
Model source: https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/tag/tts-models
The application's English voice IDs preserve the official speaker mapping.

Upstream training-data attribution:
- Koniwa tnc, under CC BY 3.0:
  https://github.com/koniwa/koniwa
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/deed.ja
- SIWIS French Speech Synthesis Database, under CC BY 4.0:
  https://datashare.ed.ac.uk/handle/10283/2353
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
These are acknowledged by the model authors at
https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M#creative-commons-attribution

The model weights and voice embeddings are unchanged from the verified upstream
release. Leap 8 exposes a subset of the included English voices. eSpeak NG
phonemization data is separately covered by the packaged GPL-3.0 license.
